purpose: Compounding decision intelligence for the Umbrella project portfolio.
decision_protocol: Store findings with confidence and decision impact

projects.name: SpecFlow
projects.hypothesis: A tool for web professionals to turn client discovery information into clear project specifications.
projects.revenue_assessment: Basic questionnaire-to-specification generation did not provide enough evidence of strong revenue viability.
projects.stronger_hypothesis: Website project scope and requirement intelligence that detects missing requirements, contradictions and scope risks before quoting or building.
lessons: A document generator is easily substituted by existing tools and AI
The intelligence layer is more valuable than the formatting output
revisit_triggers: Strong evidence that agencies will pay to reduce scope risk

projects.name: Project 1 Search
projects.objective: Find a revenue-producing digital project with the strongest realistic odds of earning, without limiting revenue to direct customer payment.

lessons: Revenue creation is the goal; direct customer payment is optional.
Existing demand is generally preferable to manufacturing demand.
A project needs an identifiable money mechanism before serious development.
Projects should be easy to test and easy to park or kill.
Research should compound instead of restarting from generic idea lists.
